fusions.name: Arrow-Borne Challenge
fusions.desc: Shoots an arrow with a written challenge tied to the shaft for 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its maximum range of 8 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to open [Karma] against the target for 6 seconds: your blows on it land harder and its blows land softer.

fusions.name: Loosed Quire
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second draw, looses 5 arrows fletched with torn pages at once, spread apart, each dealing 12 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Unrolled to Length
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Bodkin Nib
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
